targetAudience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on
coreInsight: A gentle prompt to call a family member today.

hookVariants.text: Who would love your call today?
When did you last call home?

selectedHook: Who would love your call today?
selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

script.onScreen: Who in your family would love a call from you today? / Call them, then reply here.

caption:
Who in your family would love to hear from you today?

A parent, a grandparent, a cousin you keep meaning to call.

Reply after you call.

#IslamicReminder #Family #DailyDeen

primaryCta.text: Reply: who will you call today?

sourcesNote: Quotes pulled verbatim from the pinned datasets in sources/sources.json; everything else is our own reflection.

claims.text: This is a question to followers, not a teaching.
